thread:
tom: quick RFC follow-up: we need a compatibility shim for /v1/batch_predictions -> /v2/batch/envelope. v2 wraps each item with metadata and changes `req_id` -> `request_id`. goal: avoid breaking SDKs that still POST arrays.
priya: what are the required transforms?
tom: map array -> {items:[...]} envelope, rename keys, lift top-level params into envelope.meta, preserve original item ordering, and support legacy per-item callbacks via an X-Compat-CB header. also translate per-item error semantics (v1 used 200 + errors array; v2 uses 207 Multi-Status).
emily: multi-status mapping is tricky for proxies. shim should keep returning 200 for legacy clients and include `legacy_errors` array to avoid client-side 207 parsing issues. add a response header `X-Deprecated-Version: v1` so downstream tooling can pick it up.
carlos: infra: sidecar pool behind api-gateway. heuristics to detect legacy clients: User-Agent + request shape. rollout: header opt-in first, tenant flag next, then default after 45 days. also need quota/billing mapping since v2 bills per-item differently.
priya: telemetry: emit compat.batch.applied with tags: tenant, batch_size, mapping_mode, errors. track average extra latency; target <2ms p50.
emily: testing: create a 40-item batch with mixed success/errors and ensure shim normalizes caches and per-item ids. watch for duplicate dedupe keys: v1 used idx-based ids, v2 uses uuid. shim must generate stable request_id mapping and surface it back to caller.
infra-bot: deploy-preview: batch-compat-sidecar canary launched (id: batch-compat-canary-11). dashboards provisioned.
tom: I'll draft RFC note and attach the mapping table. Priya and Emily to own tests and docs. Thanks. :thumbsup:
